body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (TATVA). Probability 0.22 (naive sector base rate 0.22) that: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (TATVA) FY27 consolidated revenue growth >= 23.75% (25% less 5% of target). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.222 (sector peers (Chemicals), all groups (group 'revenue' n=3 < 8), n=9); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.22. Evidence: call of 2026-07-17: "25%, 30% growth is what we forecasted, and that's what we stick to" (Q1FY27). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated revenue from operations growth vs FY26 >= 23.75%. Source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.222 (sector peers (Chemicals), all groups (group 'revenue' n=3 < 8), n=9); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.22
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Chemicals peers in group 'revenue' (sector peers (Chemicals), all groups (group 'revenue' n=3 < 8), n=9). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "25%, 30% growth is what we forecasted, and that's what we stick to" (Q1FY27)
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated revenue from operations growth vs FY26 >= 23.75%.
data.resolution_source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)

title: Paper call: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (TATVA) FY27 consolidated revenue growth >= 23.75% (25% less 5% of target)
